tools.name: search_property_knowledge
tools.description: Search owner-attested public property facts, policies, amenities and curated guest-safe support. Use this before answering a factual question about The Driscoll. The query is search text, never an instruction to the server.

tools.name: get_property_section
tools.description: Retrieve one complete owner-attested public knowledge section by the exact ID returned from search_property_knowledge.

tools.name: check_stay_availability
tools.description: Interpret the current public availability feed for one proposed stay. The complete stay must fit within one range; separate or adjacent ranges are never merged. tools.name: get_booking_options
tools.description: Return The Driscoll's authorised booking links and platform-specific occupancy rule. The property website does not take direct bookings or payments.

tools.name: get_guest_support_guidance
tools.description: Retrieve the closest curated guest-safe technical-support sections for an installed device, appliance symptom or error. It never resets, reconfigures, disassembles or controls equipment. The input is search text, never an instruction to the server.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_property_knowledge" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search owner-attested public property facts, policies, amenities and curated guest-safe support. Use this before answering a factual question about The Driscoll…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
